svg.text: Settings: The Control Panel Behind It All
Everything from the earlier slides — model, provider, gateways, safety — is configured in one place.

g.text: the same idea as hermes config. Pick
the model, Apply; it’s used for new chats.
Backup models if the main one fails,
helper models for side jobs, and a
Mixture of Agents that combines several.
speed for depth. Context window override
plus export/import to back it all up.
The app is a front end to the same config we set by hand with hermes config — same settings, just easier to see and change.
